authorityAndDifferentials.odaSpecification: The extracted ODA v5.4.1 specification contains no AcDbShLoft, AcDbShRevolve, ACSH_LOFT_CLASS or ACSH_REVOLVE_CLASS layout entry. Its primitive bit encodings do not identify these proprietary class field sequences.

peerSchemas.observation: The available peer schemas describe the same shared-prefix, 2RD revolve-direction and Loft count sequence. They do not adjudicate this profile: the current local decodes fail or produce implausible values, and peer field declarations are not independent producer/semantic evidence.

disposition: Keep the failed frames raw-retained but unvalidated, keep reader completeness partial, and keep strict-complete DXF output refused. Do not change field offsets/types or admit the records from count plausibility alone.
